title: Update RPL dodag prefix handling for 02xx::
description: Update lichen_rpl_dodag prefix advertisement and acceptance to use 02xx:: Yggdrasil prefix instead of ULA fd00::. Files: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/dodag.c, lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/include/lichen/rpl_dodag.h, lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_prefix.c. ~15 lines across 2-3 files. Depends on zt3c.7.2.
close_reason: No-op completion: the fd00:: ULA coupling this bead targeted is already gone from lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/{dodag.c,rpl_dodag.h,rpl_prefix.c} — the C RPL core is prefix-agnostic (DODAGID opaque 16B, DAO Target encoding length-generic per rpl_messages.h:430-445) and never hardcoded fd00. The migration landed via sibling-bead commits on beads-worker-3: 90ae5e2410 (rpl ztests to 02xx, closed .7.6/.7.7), 05ad7ba628 (gateway root DODAG ID 0200::), 3193e837d2 (Kconfig text, .7.1), with .7.3/.7.5 also closed. Sweep of lichen/subsys + rpl/routing tests finds zero fd00 minters outside the fixture helpers already tracked in 025x; rpl_dodag test at main.c:501 now asserts legacy-ULA DODAG_IDs are foreign. C and Python consistently treat DODAGID acceptance as opaque (dodag.c:406 vs dodag.py:413) — no cross-impl divergence. Verified: rpl_dodag host suite 23/23 PASS (gcc-14, incl. 'native 0200 DODAG global path' and 'unjoined foreign DODAG rejected'). Codereview: prior session ran 2 independent passes on this bead's area (findings -> .7.2 comment on 025x-related make_ula, since addressed); this round produced zero new diff, so no new review passes required. Parent zt3c.7 now has all children closed.
